content.what_it_is: MATLAB rip-tracking snapshot plotter. It loads and crops bathymetry to a hard-coded 312-by-100 grid and builds a 1 m by 2 m mesh (L3-L13), fixes the processed range to frame 10 (L19-L28), loads mean velocity/elevation/mask plus tracker x/y tables (L30-L45), and plots eta, curl vorticity, and depth/quiver panels with the same tracked path overlaid in all three (L46-L107).
entities: dep1 full bathymetry and dep cropped/masked bathymetry @L5,L13,L42
unresolved: `dep` is created once before the loop at L13 and then destructively masked at L42. The active one-frame range hides the effect, but any restored multi-frame range would retain NaNs from every earlier mask and prevent re-wetted cells from returning in the depth panel.
Depth is cropped with fixed n=100,m=312 at L8-L13 without checking dep1 size; frame fields are likewise not checked against this fixed mesh before logical masking and curl.
The depth subplot's caxis [-12,0] at L88 is overwritten by [-12,2.5] at L93. `w_ang` and `icount` are unused after assignment.

tk_x.txt and tk_y.txt are reloaded inside every frame at L37-L38 and only column 2 is plotted at L57,L80,L101, independent of `num`; the file does not document whether column 2 is an entire trajectory or a fixed particle selection.
